purpose: Execute authorized marketing actions on real channels using available integrations while preserving exact targets, budgets, publication state, rollback/recovery and evidence.
outputs: channel execution/publication/activation evidence and resulting identifiers/status
gate: The intended channel action was performed on the exact authorized target/configuration, consequential effects are confirmed or explicitly unknown, and recovery/rollback is known when applicable.
human_review_triggers: campaign activation/deactivation when policy requires approval
